title: π0.5 · 1,000 demos · 30k updates · full digital sisters
description: 21 object variants ×10 lighting conditions; ten paired trials per cell, all three videos. Prime / PGX / Trantor over QSFP.
cameraSetup: September22 raw-view registered NexiGo + original left wrist; native optics/photometry
pickRule: At least 25mm above initial center for five consecutive pre-action frames, with jaw contact in every frame.
placeRule: Sustained pick AND completed contact-v1 placement: supporting corners within rim, fixed inside-height bound, settled speed <.03m/s, no jaw contact throughout final1.5s, full execution.

experiment.title: π0.5 · 1,000 demos · 30k updates · full digital sisters
experiment.description: 21 object variants ×10 lighting conditions; ten paired trials per cell, all three videos. Prime / PGX / Trantor over QSFP.

limitations: The locally preserved camera JPEGs are external_left. Other camera images are unavailable in this snapshot. Baseline native config recovered byte-identically from a later frozen source workspace; other per-scene configs remain represented by their native SHA, layout and lighting.
The full native API snapshot preserves exact source config SHA256 values, layouts and lighting. The interactive scene has separate source provenance.
Automatic completion and verification are distinct from whole-video human review.

inspection.notes: Codex reviewed 234 sampled frames across all three cameras for the first four paired trials in baseline, warm and cool lighting. The 12-trial snapshot contains two sustained picks and one strict placement; the sampled visuals agree. These are partial simulation results, not a completed matrix or full-motion review.

config.task: Pick up the white box and put it in the bowl.

measured_rgb_response.source: Current before_238 real patches vs native_preview02; simulator camera response only. Never apply to physical feeds.

joint_bridge.status: Offline encoder-to-CAD geometric estimate. Never written to physical calibration. Model URDF angle limits translated by the identical offsets, preserving motor-space limits.

config.bowl_placement_source: Fresh two-view manually annotated outer-rim fit, fixed dimensions/table height
config.table_registration_source: bowl_body_height_diagnostic.json; bottom silhouette resolves rim-height/table-height ambiguity approximately
config.registration_review: Current physical raw mounts, nominal manually reset object arrangement, simulation-only arm geometry fit. Held-out wrist median6-7px/max11.42px; full equivalence is not established.
config.joint_response_provenance: runs/experiment_30000/joint_response_trace_fit.json; integration replay response_isaac_v1; seven fresh negative-direction elbow endpoints agree within 0.73 deg of the 3.0945-deg hysteresis offset, see response_endpoint_check.json
config.appearance_status: Approximate open U camera bracket and connector, gray shells/black servo materials and pink illumination. Physical camera enclosure position, cables and background still have documented appearance residuals; camera model is validated by held-out image points.
config.box_label_orientation_review: Yaw modulo 180 chosen from geometry; +180 selected after actual three-view Isaac/physical label review.
